identitySignals: The Principal Leadership Institute (PLI) is a program of UC Berkeley's Graduate School of Education (now Berkeley School of Education), in Berkeley, CA, matching the agenda text and location.
The PLI page mentions an Oakland Unified School District partnership (OUSD and UC Berkeley grant to grow a diverse leadership pipeline), and the FAQ lists Oakland among its partner districts.
PLI trains school principals and administrators, consistent with an OUSD Talent/Human Resources memorandum of understanding.
research.notes: This is a program within a University of California school, not a separate legal entity; the contracting entity is likely The Regents of the University of California. Registry IDs, legal name, phone and mailing address were left null because they are not shown on PLI pages.

profile.summary: The Principal Leadership Institute is a graduate program at the University of California, Berkeley's School of Education. It is a 14-month program that prepares school leaders for Bay Area public schools. Graduates receive a master's degree in educational administration and a preliminary administrative services credential. It partners with school districts including Oakland, Berkeley, San Francisco and West Contra Costa.
